devicedata.name: Shield Bridge

property.name: Bridge Address
property.tooltip: IP address (or host:port) of the Shield running the Shield Bridge app. Port defaults to 8765.

property.name: API Key
property.tooltip: Only needed if 'Require API key' was switched on in the Shield Bridge app.

property.name: Shield MAC Address
property.tooltip: Used for Wake-on-LAN before launching. Shown in the Shield under Settings > Device Preferences > About > Status.

property.name: Wake on Select
property.tooltip: Send Wake-on-LAN and a wake request to the Shield whenever this source is selected or an item is launched.

property.name: Select Room Source
property.tooltip: Whether a launch also selects Shield Bridge in the room. Leave on Never when launching from Navigator. Use Select Shield Bridge if a keypad or scene should turn the room on and start a show; it is skipped when the room is already on Shield Bridge.

property.name: Launch Delay (ms)
property.tooltip: Wait this long after selecting the room source before telling the Shield to launch, so a TV that is still warming up does not miss the opening.

property.name: After Launch
property.tooltip: What happens after starting a show. Switch to Remote moves the room to Shield Bridge Remote, the standard Control4 remote screen; the poster stays on Shield Bridge's own Now Playing.

property.name: Shield Control Device
property.tooltip: The driver that actually controls the Shield (it can sit in any room). Remote and transport buttons pressed on Shield Bridge are relayed to it.

property.name: Shield Control Device ID
property.tooltip: Optional. Type the Shield driver's device ID here if it does not appear in the picker above. Overrides the picker.

property.name: Forward Remote Commands
property.tooltip: Relay remote and transport buttons to the Shield Control Device.

property.name: Refresh Interval (s)
property.tooltip: How often the driver refreshes its cached list for programming (keypad buttons). 0 disables background refresh.

property.name: Search API Key
property.tooltip: Free key from Movie of the Night (docs.movieofthenight.com, Authentication guide) or from RapidAPI. Needed for search results inside Control4.

property.name: Search API Service
property.tooltip: Where the Search API Key came from.

property.name: Search Country
property.tooltip: Two-letter country code (us, ca, gb ...). Results only include what streams in this country.

property.name: Show Titles Not On Shield
property.tooltip: Also list matches that only stream on services whose app is not installed on the Shield, under their own heading.
